| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| `resource_type` | `string` | **yes** | The kind of resource the comment is on. One of `invoice`, `credit_note`, `customer`, `subscription`, `product`, `price`, `coupon`, `coupon_set`, `product_group`. |
| `resource_id` | `string` | **yes** | The id of the resource the comment is on. |
| `body` | `string` | **yes** | The comment's text. |
